prompt: The client wants to know which channel is driving the growth in new customers. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Search brings in the most new customers, 42k
options.feedback: True, but search grew only 2k. The question is what is driving the growth.
Referral grew 1k (30k to 31k); social grew 10k (25k to 35k).

options.text: Social customers are cheaper to win
options.feedback: The chart shows customer numbers, not acquisition cost.

options.text: Social drove most of the growth
options.feedback: Right. New customers rose from 100k to 112k; social went from 25k to 35k.

explanation: New customers rose from 100k to 112k. Social added 10k of it (25k to 35k); search added 2k and referral 1k, and TV fell 1k.
